chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Bukayr, from his father, who said:
Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام said: “Whoever approaches a woman of unmarriageable kinship, he is struck with a blow of the sword that takes from him whatever it takes.”

key_terms.أَخَذَتْ مِنْهُ مَا أَخَذَتْ: it takes from him whatever it takes; an expression indicating an uncompromising fatal strike
key_terms.ذَاتَ مَحْرَمٍ: a woman within the prohibited degrees of kinship whom one may never lawfully marry
key_terms.ضَرْبَةً بِالسَّيْفِ: a strike with the sword; a severe corporal punishment described in the ruling
key_terms.ضُرِبَ: he is struck; indicating the execution of a prescribed punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for zina with a mahram in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning intercourse with a woman within the prohibited degrees of kinship. It indicates the severe hadd punishment attached to this act in Shia jurisprudential tradition and reflects the grave sanctity of family boundaries.
